body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> LG unveiled ‘&37'', 2.4-inch TFT-LCD MP3P equipped with Touch User Interface during KES 2006. It features 4GB memory, mobile XD engine covered with high-end aluminum body. You can play music for 24 hours and video file up-to 3 hours. In addition it supports photo viewer and e-Book.
